brief: A two-bin kitchen herb planter, one with mint and one with basil, both in soil.

requirements.evidence: Two adjacent full bases piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full, joined, each holding a hex-bin-full bin.
fillSoil on bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full + mint-young plant (prop:1), visible from above

requirements.evidence: fillSoil on bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full + basil-young plant (prop:2), visible from above
requirements.requirement: One bin with basil in soil

requirements.evidence: Kitchen use shown by compact two-cell herb-bin layout; check_build ok, meshClash clear, no prop warnings.

finish.summary: Two-cell planter: two full bases joined, each with a full-depth bin filled with soil — one planted with mint, one with basil. House rules applied, checks clear, both plants visible from above.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
